answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 5474 Country: Pakistan Title: I live in uk. my question is since i have started namaz.when im offering any namaz i always feel that my wozo is breaken. some time i do 2 wozo twice. it only happens in namaz. what shall i do? Question: I live in uk. my question is since i have started namaz.when im offering any namaz i always feel that my wozo is breaken. some time i do 2 wozo twice. it only happens in namaz. what shall i do? Answer ID: 5474 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 976/724=H) Wuzu will not break only by such feeling. After completing salah , get busy doing your work and do not pay attention to the feeling. By doing so, your problem will be solved within a few days, In-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
